title: Share your work
brief:
Origin is where the team reads main. Your fix is invisible to them until you push it.

Fix the bug in `app.txt` (click the file in the working tree panel to open your editor), commit the fix, and push it so `origin/main` carries your work.
hints: Edit app.txt from the working tree panel, then git add app.txt and git commit -m "fix the bug".
git push copies your new commit to origin and slides origin/main forward to match.
